# Review Policy
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Review Levels

| Level | Use when | Agent action |
|---|---|---|
| None | Low-risk reversible work | Continue and report result |
| Review | Human judgment materially affects downstream work | Stop and request review |
| Approval | Governance, commitment, release, or irreversible action | Stop and request explicit approval |

## Default Rule

If a downstream step would make an important decision harder or more expensive to reverse, require review before proceeding.

## Quality Rule

Quality failure is corrected by the agent when the needed information and authority are available. It is not treated as a human review request. If the agent needs user information, access, authority, or a human decision to continue production or pass quality, it records a `Blocked` state and asks one focused question.

An explicit user request to stop records a `Paused` state. Both `Blocked` and `Paused` runs can resume from their recorded stage.
